title: Site-Wide Laundry Service
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ARGONNE NATL LAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: UChicago Argonne, LLC, Operator of Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) requires approximately 400 employees to be guaranteed a uniform at all times. Contractor shall provide laundry service, lab coat purchase program, and rental services for uniforms, lab coats, shop towels and face coverings, all-inclusive of supplies, materials, labor and delivery.
